data.title: Ava at Palm Jumeirah
data.about:
Welcome to Ava at Palm Jumeirah. This is the most exclusive project in the city. Offering only 17 apartments, residents will have the entire floor to themselves. With fantastic views of the city’s skyline and the blue sea, this is an elite residential destination.

Choose from Apartments and Penthouses designed to perfection by Portia Fox. You come home to private pool and private terraces providing you with 270 degree views and a lifestyle that only a few can enjoy and everyone covets.
